description: Two side-by-side aerial images compare different spatial resolutions of satellite data over an urban area featuring dense building structures, streets, green spaces, and a railway line. The left panel, labelled "S2 10 m", displays Sentinel-2 imagery at 10-metre resolution, showing a pixelated view where individual buildings and narrow streets are blurred. The right panel, labelled "Pre-trained S2SR 2.5 m", displays super-resolved Sentinel-2 imagery at 2.5-metre resolution, revealing significantly finer detail, with distinct building outlines, clear street networks, individual trees, and detailed railway tracks and platforms. Both images include a scale bar indicating "0", "250", and "500 m". The comparison highlights the enhanced clarity and detail achieved through super-resolution processing, which is crucial for Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) mapping in urban environments.
